newsitem.title: CHINA: China names head of Foreign Ministry office in HK.
newsitem.headline: China names head of Foreign Ministry office in HK.

text.p: China on Thursday announced the appointment of seasoned diplomat Ma Yuzhen to serve as the head of the Chinese Foreign Ministry's Hong Kong office after the territory returns to Beijing rule on July 1.

"The central government has decided to set up the People's Republic of China Foreign Ministry office in Hong Kong on July 1 and names Ma Yuzhen as its head," Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai told a news briefing.
Cui gave no further details of Ma's appointment.

Ma is currently the deputy director of the Information Office of the State Council, or cabinet. He has formerly served as ambassador to Britain and as director of the Foreign Ministry's information department.
Hong Kong newspapers had speculated that the first head of the Foreign Ministry's office in Hong Kong would be the current Chinese ambassador to Britain, Jiang Enzhu.
